name: Expert Tumbler
body:
You are able to avoid being attacked while tumbling, even by powerful creatures.

Prerequisites: Dex 15, Acrobatics 5 ranks

Benefit: Whenever you use an Acrobatics check to move through a threatened square without provoking an attack of opportunity, the DC to 10 + the target’s Base Attack Bonus + the target’s Dexterity modifier. Any other conditional modifiers, like +5 to the DC when moving through an enemy’s space, still apply if applicable.

Normal: Without this feat, to move through a threatened square without provoking an attack of opportunity with Acrobatics, the DC is the target’s CMD (10 + strength modifier + dexterity modifier + size modifier).

Special: A rogue may select this feat as a rogue talent.
